name: Chocolate Ice-Cream No. 2
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: grated chocolate
ingredients.originalText: half a cupful of grated chocolate

instructions.text: Beat two eggs very light and cream them with two cupfuls of sugar
Scald a pint of milk and turn on by degrees, mixing well with the sugar and eggs
Stir in half a cupful of grated chocolate
Return to the fire and heat until it thickens, stirring briskly
Take off and set aside to cool

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat two eggs very light and cream them with two cupfuls of sugar
2. Scald a pint of milk and turn on by degrees, mixing well with the sugar and eggs
3. Stir in half a cupful of grated chocolate
4. Return to the fire and heat until it thickens, stirring briskly
5. Take off and set aside to cool
6. When thoroughly cold, freeze
